verdict.rationale: Motion's first-party docs cover the whole story. It slots tasks into calendar time windows by deadline, blocks calendar time for recurring tasks, schedules around actual capacity, and reshuffles the day and week automatically when meetings run long or emergencies arise. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the automatic re-planning and deadline-aware scheduling work as claimed.

support.subject: As a knowledge worker, AI schedules my tasks into real calendar blocks around meetings and deadlines, and re-plans automatically when things change

citations.quote: Create custom time windows for your tasks and watch Motion slot them in perfectly, ensuring you never miss a deadline.
When meetings run long or emergencies arise, Motion reshuffles your entire day (and week) in seconds—protecting your time and mental bandwidth from manual reorganization.
Create daily, weekly, monthly, or quarterly tasks and Motion's AI Task Manager will block time on your calendar regularly so you get them done on time.
Motion schedules tasks based on your actual capacity and flags when you've scheduled more than you can handle
Motion's AI scheduling algorithm will automatically put them on your calendar.
